papers.title: Robotic versus laparoscopic total mesorectal excision for rectal cancer: long-term oncological outcomes from a multicenter randomized trial
papers.authors: Chen W, Yamamoto T, Park S, Mueller H
papers.abstract: Background: Robotic surgery has been increasingly adopted for rectal cancer treatment. Methods: We conducted a multicenter RCT comparing robotic versus laparoscopic TME. Results: 5-year local recurrence rate was significantly lower in the robotic group (4.2% vs 8.1%, p=0.03). Conversion rate was also significantly lower. Conclusion: Robotic TME demonstrates superior oncological outcomes.
papers.summary: 本研究為多中心隨機對照試驗，比較機器手臂與腹腔鏡全直腸繫膜切除術（TME）的長期腫瘤學成果。機器手臂組的5年局部復發率（4.2%）顯著低於腹腔鏡組（8.1%），轉換開腹率亦明顯較低。此結果支持機器手臂TME作為直腸癌手術的優先選擇，尤其適用於骨盆腔較狹窄的患者。

papers.title: Transanal total mesorectal excision (TaTME) learning curve: analysis of 500 consecutive cases at a high-volume center
papers.authors: Liang R, Santos J, Kim D
papers.abstract: Objective: To define the learning curve for TaTME. Methods: 500 consecutive TaTME cases were analyzed for operative time, conversion rate, and complication rates. Results: The learning curve plateau was achieved after approximately 40-50 cases, with significant improvements in operative time and complication rates. A structured training program was key.
papers.summary: 本研究分析單一高量中心連續500例經肛門全直腸繫膜切除術（TaTME），定義其學習曲線。術者在完成約40-50例後手術效率與併發症率顯著改善並趨於穩定。研究強調結構化訓練計畫的必要性，建議新術者在導師指導下完成至少50例才可獨立執行。

papers.title: Enhanced recovery after colorectal surgery: impact of a comprehensive ERAS protocol on 30-day readmission rates
papers.authors: Okonkwo A, Bergmann L, Nakamura Y
papers.abstract: Background: ERAS protocols have transformed perioperative care. We evaluated the impact of a comprehensive ERAS protocol on postoperative outcomes. Results: Implementation of ERAS significantly reduced length of stay (4.2 vs 6.8 days), 30-day readmission (8% vs 14%), and total costs. Patient satisfaction scores also improved significantly.
papers.summary: 本研究評估全面性加速術後康復（ERAS）計畫對大腸直腸手術預後的影響。實施ERAS後，住院天數從平均6.8天降至4.2天，30天再入院率從14%降至8%，整體醫療費用亦顯著下降。研究確認ERAS計畫可有效改善手術品質並提升患者滿意度，建議各醫院全面採用。

papers.title: Predictive biomarkers for response to neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy in locally advanced rectal cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Vasquez M, Thompson A, Li X, Brown K
papers.abstract: Background: Identifying patients who will achieve pathological complete response to neoadjuvant CRT remains challenging. Methods: Systematic review of 48 studies including 6,234 patients. Results: Tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, MSI status, and baseline CEA were independent predictors. A combined biomarker panel achieved AUC of 0.84 for pCR prediction.
papers.summary: 本系統性回顧及統合分析納入48篇研究共6,234名局部晚期直腸癌患者，探討新輔助放化療病理完全緩解（pCR）之預測生物標記。腫瘤浸潤淋巴球、微衛星不穩定性（MSI）及術前CEA值為獨立預測因子，整合生物標記組合預測AUC達0.84。此結果有助於個人化治療策略，未來可篩選高pCR機率患者考慮器官保留策略。

papers.title: Long-term functional outcomes after sphincter-preserving surgery for low rectal cancer: a prospective cohort study
papers.authors: Fernandez E, Andersen P, Zhou Q
papers.abstract: Objective: To evaluate long-term bowel function and quality of life after sphincter-preserving surgery for low rectal cancer. Results: Low anterior resection syndrome (LARS) was present in 58% of patients at 2 years, with major LARS in 31%. Biofeedback therapy significantly improved LARS scores. Diverting ileostomy closure timing did not affect functional outcomes.
papers.summary: 本前瞻性世代研究追蹤低位直腸癌保肛手術後的長期腸道功能，發現術後2年仍有58%患者存在低前切除症候群（LARS），其中重度LARS佔31%。生物回饋治療可顯著改善LARS評分，而預防性迴腸造口的關閉時機對功能預後無顯著影響。研究建議將LARS篩查納入術後常規追蹤，並積極轉介生物回饋訓練。
